# jumpcloud_user_group (Data Source)

Looks up a JumpCloud user group by its exact name. Fails unless exactly one group matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_user_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, matched exactly and case-sensitively.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description.
- `email` (String) Group email address.
- `id` (String) User group ID.
- `membership_method` (String) `STATIC` or `NOTSET` for static groups, `DYNAMIC_AUTOMATED` or `DYNAMIC_REVIEW_REQUIRED` for dynamic ones.
- `query` (String) Membership rule as JSON for dynamic groups, empty for static groups.
